plan.understanding: Replace the central flower-shaped torque interface in the separate hub body with a centered, consistently clocked hexagonal through-profile while leaving the surrounding gear body unchanged.

subtasks.goal: Edit the imported part by direct shell-face replacement, not by filling and recutting. First snapshot and separate the two input solids using both measured invariants, without relying on result-list order: the target is the compact solid with volume 2162.777 mm^3 and bbox [-15.75, -4.625, -15.75] to [15.75, 3.175, 15.75], distinguished additionally by its full cylindrical exterior face of radius 15.75 mm about world Y; the protected solid has volume 27615.571 mm^3 and bbox [-56.511, -6.35, -56.604] to [56.511, 3.175, 56.234]. Freeze the protected solid as an untouched original copy. On the compact solid, identify the centered flower opening by its 192-edge inner loops on the +Y mouth at Y=3.175 and -Y mouth at Y=-4.625, centered at X=0, Z=0, and remove only the complete connected cavity-wall face set incident to those loops. Rebuild the affected shell directly: retrim each adjacent mouth or intermediate partition face with one regular hexagonal inner wire, and install six sharp planar wall faces parallel to world Y, split at any inherited Y-level shell seams needed for manifold sewing. The hexagon has circumradius exactly 10.5 mm and X-Z vertices (9.093267, 5.25), (0, 10.5), (-9.093267, 5.25), (-9.093267, -5.25), (0, -10.5), and (9.093267, -5.25), corresponding to angles 30, 90, 150, 210, 270, and 330 degrees from +X toward +Z. Its walls run continuously from Y=-4.625 to Y=3.175, giving 21.0 mm across corners and 18.186533 mm across flats. Sew the six new walls and retrimmed adjacent faces to all untouched compact-solid faces, heal only coincident sewing tolerances, and validate one closed compact solid; do not use a plug, additive fill, subtractive prism, or any Boolean involving the protected solid. Export the edited compact solid first as s0 and the byte-for-byte preserved large solid second as s1, as a two-solid compound with no Boolean between them. Verify that s1 retains volume 27615.571 mm^3, its original bbox, face geometry, and topology; only s0 may change volume, while its outer bbox remains unchanged. Report s0 pre/post volume and bbox, s1 pre/post invariants, opening center, Y span, vertex angles, across-corners and across-flats dimensions. In the top view looking at the +Y face and bottom view looking at the -Y face, confirm both mouths contain the same single open sharp hexagon, with no flower scallops and no cap.
